blurb: A Victorian inventor builds a machine, travels to the year 802,701, and meets the gentle Eloi — and the Morlocks who live below.
source: Text: The Time Machine by H. G. Wells (1895), from the Standard Ebooks edition. Public domain.

streets.name: The Demonstration
streets.blurb: At a Thursday dinner, the Time Traveller shows his guests a tiny model machine of brass and ivory.
streets.how: Look at the clues in the smoking-room, then work out what happened to the model.

params.objective: Work out where the model went

clues.label: Four dimensions
clues.text: Every real thing has Length, Breadth, Thickness — and Duration. Time is the fourth dimension.

clues.label: The lever
clues.text: One lever sends the machine gliding into the future; the other reverses the motion.

clues.label: The empty table
clues.text: A candle blew out. The little machine swung round, became a ghost — and vanished.

solve.label: The model
solve.prompt: Where did the little model go?
options: Off through time — it was a time machine

streets.name: Through Time
streets.blurb: The Time Traveller pulls the lever. Night follows day like the flapping of a black wing.
streets.how: Race through the years! Jump the hurdles and collect the dial readings as time flies past.

streets.name: The Eloi
streets.blurb: In the far future, small, gentle people in bright robes welcome the Time Traveller with garlands of flowers.
streets.how: Explore the gardens of the future and find six things the little people show you.

finale.say: Weena! (She gives you a flower, and holds your hand.)

streets.name: The Missing Machine
streets.blurb: Back at the little lawn by moonlight — the Time Machine is gone!
streets.how: Search the lawn for clues, then work out where the machine has been taken.

params.objective: Find out where the machine went

clues.label: The levers
clues.text: The Time Traveller unscrewed the little levers and put them in his pocket. Nobody can drive the machine away.

clues.label: A groove
clues.text: A groove is ripped in the turf, between the marks of his feet and the pedestal of the sphinx.

clues.label: The pedestal
clues.text: The bronze pedestal has deep framed panels on each side. He taps it: the pedestal is hollow.

solve.label: The White Sphinx
options: Inside the hollow bronze pedestal of the White Sphinx
Gone back to the past by itself

streets.name: Into the Wells
streets.blurb: Deep round wells dot the land. The Time Traveller climbs down one, into the dark Under-world.
streets.how: Climb down the shaft on the metal hooks, all the way to the bottom. Collect the matches on the way.

params.objective: Climb to the bottom of the well
params.done: You reach the bottom — and strike a match.

streets.name: The Palace of Green Porcelain
streets.blurb: A huge green building turns out to be an ancient museum, full of fossils, machines and rotted books.
streets.how: Explore the dusty galleries and find six useful things.

finale.say: (Weena gazes at the strange old galleries, then runs to pick more flowers.)

streets.name: The Forest Fire
streets.blurb: Night falls in the forest. The Time Traveller lights a fire to keep the Morlocks away — and it spreads.
streets.how: Run through the dark forest away from the spreading fire, and get back to the White Sphinx.

params.objective: Get back to the White Sphinx

skyRun.name: The Ruined Towers
skyRun.blurb: up the crumbling towers of the year 802,701.
skyRun.how: Leap up the ruined towers to see the whole future valley. Some ledges move — wait for them!

params.objective: Reach the top of the highest tower

npcs.name: Weena
npcs.thanks: (Weena tucks the flowers into your pockets, laughing.)

steps.text: Talk to Weena in the garden.
steps.say: (Weena points at the gardens, then at her empty hands. She wants to make a garland.)

steps.text: Find six flowers around the town.

steps.say: (Weena laughs, makes a garland, and puts it round your neck.)

vault.name: The Laboratory
vault.blurb: an escape room in the Time Traveller’s laboratory: the far future, the return, and the two white flowers.
vault.intro: The Time Traveller’s laboratory, years later. The machine is gone again. Open three locks to understand what he saw — and what he left behind.

stations.label: The dials
stations.text: Put the journey in order, from the dinner party to the far future.
stations.lesson: He travelled further and further — until the sun itself was red and still.

items: The little model vanishes at dinner
The Morlocks hide his machine in the sphinx
He escapes and travels far into the future
He sees a red sun over a silent beach
solve.hint: Start with the model, end with the red sun.

stations.label: Two white flowers
stations.text: The narrator keeps two strange white flowers, shrivelled and brown, that Weena put in the Time Traveller’s pocket.
stations.lesson: “Even when mind and strength had gone, gratitude and a mutual tenderness still lived on in the heart of man.”

solve.prompt: What do the two white flowers show?
options: That kindness and gratitude can last, even in a dark future
That the story was made up
solve.hint: Who gave him the flowers, and why?

quiz.label: The Traveller’s story
quiz.lesson: From a Thursday dinner to the end of the world — and back.

vault.openText: The laboratory door creaks open. The machine is gone.
vault.outro: The Time Traveller went off with a camera and a knapsack — and has not come back. Perhaps he is still travelling.
